According to the course material, how many elements of a behavioral manipulation method are there? (answer in figures)
three

There are three principal elements of a behavioral manipulation method: - a behavior of the pest, - a means by which the behavior is manipulated appropriately, and - a method that utilizes the behavioral manipulation for protection of a resource from the pest.
